unwrappedError.text: This error is formatted with `{{verb}}`, which keeps its text and drops the error itself, so `errors.Is` and `errors.As` in every caller can no longer find it. Format it with `%w` instead, which keeps the error reachable to `errors.Is` and `errors.As` and prints it as `%v` does.

rebuiltError.text: This builds a new error from the text of `{{error}}`, which drops the original, so `errors.Is` and `errors.As` in every caller can no longer find it. Wrap the error itself instead, with `fmt.Errorf("<what was being done>: %w", {{error}})`, which keeps it reachable to `errors.Is` and `errors.As` and prints it as `%v` does.
